annotation.title_clean: Hoja de Ruta para el Desarrollo y Aplicación de la Inteligencia Artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: Roadmap for the Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence in Colombia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (MinCiencias), Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombia's Ministry of Science roadmap for ethical and sustainable AI adoption. It sets a baseline, challenges, a mission and innovation routes, and an action plan across five environments: ethics and governance, education and research, data and organizations, emerging industries, and privacy, cybersecurity and defense. Robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines a mission and general and specific objectives for ethical, sustainable AI adoption in Colombia
Organizes the action plan into five environments, including ethics and governance and privacy, cybersecurity and defense
Maps innovation focus areas to technology readiness levels (TRL)
Highlights algorithmic transparency and bias as key ethical challenges, citing UNESCO 2021
Sets monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for the roadmap
